name: Scrubs
tagline: An iPhone app that finds and masks patient identifiers in clinical photos before they are shared.
problem: Clinicians share photos that contain protected health information, and redacting by hand is tedious.
solution: On-device OCR, a PHI classifier and face detection mask names, record numbers, birth dates and faces, then export a clean copy.
demo_moment: Team-described: import a photo of a chart and get a redacted version in seconds.

why_it_stood_out.claim: No patient data leaves the device.

lessons: A narrow, compliance-driven task makes a crisp on-device demo.
